author: perrotta
body:
The following GTs in autoCond are updated by freezing the corresponding online ones up to the latest IOVs until the end of Run3. In addition 161X_dataRun3_Prompt_frozen_v1 contains the EGM online regression needed by HI at the analysis level (i.e., they have no effect on online-like workflows):
- [161X_dataRun3_HLT_frozen_v1](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/161X_dataRun3_HLT_frozen_v1), and its [diff](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/161X_dataRun3_HLT_frozen260520_v1/161X_dataRun3_HLT_frozen_v1) wrt the previous frozen one
- [161X_dataRun3_Express_frozen_v1](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/161X_dataRun3_Express_frozen_v1), and its [diff](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/161X_dataRun3_Express_frozen260520_v1/161X_dataRun3_Express_frozen_v1) wrt the previous frozen one
- [161X_dataRun3_Prompt_frozen_v1](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/161X_dataRun3_Prompt_frozen_v1), and its [diff](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/161X_dataRun3_Prompt_frozen260520_v1/161X_dataRun3_Prompt_frozen_v1) wrt the previous frozen one

The following HI MC GTs in autoCond are updated as follows:

- 'phase1_2023_realistic_hi' -> [141X_mcRun3_2023_realistic_HI_v15](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/141X_mcRun3_2023_realistic_HI_v15):
  - [Difference wrt 141X_mcRun3_2023_realistic_HI_v11](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/141X_mcRun3_2023_realistic_HI_v11/141X_mcRun3_2023_realistic_HI_v15) (previous in autoCond)
  - Rename the dE/dx calibration tag to contain "2023" in the name, see https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/gt-mc-request-changing-de-dx-calibration-tag-name-for-2023-pbpb-mc-gt-in-141x/128863
  - Add EGM regression tags as requested in https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/request-of-new-mc-gt-for-131x-141x-and-151x/148065

- 'phase1_2024_realistic_hi' -> [141X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_HI_v20](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/141X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_HI_v20):
  - [Difference wrt 141X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_HI_v17](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/141X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_HI_v17/141X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_HI_v20) (previous in autoCond)
  - Add EGM regression tags as requested in https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/request-of-new-mc-gt-for-131x-141x-and-151x/148065

- 'phase1_2025_realistic_hi' -> [151X_mcRun3_2025_realistic_HI_v8](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/151X_mcRun3_2025_realistic_HI_v8):
  - [Difference wrt 151X_mcRun3_2025_realistic_HI_v5](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/151X_mcRun3_2025_realistic_HI_v5/151X_mcRun3_2025_realistic_HI_v8) (previous in autoCond)
  - Add EGM regression tags as requested in https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/request-of-new-mc-gt-for-131x-141x-and-151x/148065

- 'phase1_2026_realistic_hi' -> [161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v4](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v4):
  - [Difference wrt 161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v2](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v2/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v4)  (previous in autoCond)
  - It contains all the latest MC conditions for HI MC 2026. The details are mentioned in this thread: https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/gt-mc-hin-request-for-a-pbpb-run-mc-queue-in-161x/143262/38
  - Also updated the BeamSpot tags as from [cmsTalk[(https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/gt-mc-hin-request-for-a-pbpb-run-mc-queue-in-161x/143262/42)

Successfully tested in master
